tutorials.title: How to make this desert planet movie intro using Claude
tutorials.trend: Dune: Part Three jde do kin 18. 12. a holiday preview (Tom's Guide, Rotten Tomatoes) ho řadí mezi top filmy; 'inspired by' intro s dunami a dvěma měsíci, bez loga.
steps: Tell Claude: a desert planet at sunrise, two moons, slow camera over the dunes.
Add your own title in a wide, spaced-out font.
Claude builds it, you tweak it.

tutorials.title: How to make this Thanksgiving table that fills itself using Claude
tutorials.trend: Díkůvzdání je ve čtvrtek 26. 11.; stůl, na který postupně 'naskakují' jídla, sedí na sváteční stories.
steps: Ask Claude for an empty dinner table seen from above.
Have each dish pop in one by one: turkey, pie, candles.
End on your own message on the tablecloth.
Claude builds it, you tweak it.

tutorials.title: How to make this cozy fireplace live wallpaper using Claude
tutorials.trend: S prvním mrazem se na TikToku a YouTube vrací 'cozy winter' ambience (krb, sníh za oknem); živá tapeta na mobil, kterou si každý chce stáhnout.
steps: Ask Claude for a crackling fireplace with glowing embers in phone size.
Add snow falling behind a window next to it.
Claude builds it, you tweak it.

tutorials.title: How to make this frosted window you can draw on using Claude
tutorials.trend: Zimní 'napiš prstem na zamlžené okno' efekt je klasika prosincových stories; interaktivní verze, kde prst stírá námrazu.
steps: Ask Claude for a frosted window with city lights behind it.
Make your finger wipe the frost away where you draw.
Claude builds it, you tweak it.

tutorials.title: How to turn your selfie into a crime-game cover art using Higgsfield
tutorials.trend: Velká open-world crime hra právě vyšla a feedy jsou plné selfie v ilustrovaném stylu jejích obalů; jen 'inspired by', žádné logo ani postavy.
steps: Prompt: painted crime-game cover art, neon sunset, palm trees, bold panels.
Pick the best one and animate it in 5 seconds.
Higgsfield builds it, you tweak it.
tutorials.cost: kredity Higgsfield, cca 2 za obrázek + ~10–20 za animaci
